result.instructions: Tools for GorillaDesk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which jobs are scheduled for tomorrow, and who is assigned to each?"; "Show me all unpaid invoices from the last 30 days."; "Find the customer with account number 5000 and list their locations.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GorillaDesk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run gorilladesk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gorilladesk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gorilladesk_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. gorilladesk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gorilladesk_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer with its first location (the API requires a location). Creates a new record each call; do not repeat it. POST /v1/customers.

tools.name: gorilladesk_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Update a customer. The API needs first_name on every update. PUT /v1/customers/{customerId}. Not verified on a real account: send every field you want kept, because PUT may clear fields you leave out. Read the customer first with gorilladesk_get_customer.
